name: Two Step Factor By SE
author: seplugins

sections.description:
The “Two Step Factor By SE” plugin is just plug and play plugin. Just enable the any from email, google authenticator, backup codes and dummy (dummy is used for quick login) to login with security. This plugin add more security to the login form.

Features

  • Email: After entering the username and password, an OTP will be sent to the registered user.
  • Google Authenticator: Simply scan the QR code or enter the key from the admin panel into the Google Authenticator app. The next time you log in, a Google Authenticator code will be required.
  • Backup Codes: You can generate up to 10 backup codes to use while logging in.

How to Use

  • Install the plugin
  • Go to users-> edit user Scroll to bottom to get the enable options for Two step verifications
  • enable any required option from the given options

Support & Customization

Need help? Contact us at plugins@softerector.com for support or custom development inquiries.
